sections.title: Welcome to Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Get a brief overview of what will be covered in the video.

sections.title: What You'll Learn: Mastering Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Understand the fundamental definitions of trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent).
Learn about the reciprocal trigonometric ratios (cosecant, secant, cotangent).
Apply trigonometric ratios to solve various problems involving right-angled triangles.
Evaluate trigonometric expressions and verify identities.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary of learning objectives with avatar and bullet points.

sections.title: Defining the Six Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define sine, cosine, and tangent in the context of a right-angled triangle.
Identify the hypotenuse, opposite, and adjacent sides relative to an acute angle.
Understand the reciprocal relationships for cosecant, secant, and cotangent.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for illustrating right-angled triangles, labeling sides, and visually defining each trigonometric ratio and its reciprocal.

sections.title: Finding All Ratios from a Single Given Ratio
learning_goals: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find the missing side of a right-angled triangle when one trigonometric ratio is given.
Calculate all six trigonometric ratios for a given angle from the side lengths.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly demonstrate the step-by-step process of constructing the triangle, applying Pythagoras, and deriving all ratios.

sections.title: Proving Angle Equality Using Sine Ratios
learning_goals: Understand how to use trigonometric ratios to prove relationships between angles.
Apply the concept of similar triangles in conjunction with trigonometric ratios.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for drawing and manipulating multiple triangles, highlighting corresponding sides and angles, and demonstrating proportionality.

sections.title: Evaluating Trigonometric Expressions and Identities
learning_goals: Evaluate complex trigonometric expressions using known ratios and identities.
Verify trigonometric identities by substituting values and simplifying expressions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can display mathematical expressions clearly, show substitution steps, and animate the simplification process to verify identities.

sections.title: Finding Ratios from Side Relationships
learning_goals: Solve problems where trigonometric ratios are derived from given relationships between the sides of a right-angled triangle.
Utilize algebraic methods alongside the Pythagorean theorem to find unknown side lengths.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is suitable for illustrating the triangle, setting up equations based on side relationships, and showing the algebraic steps to find the ratios.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Recall the definitions of sine, cosine, tangent, and their reciprocals.
Remember how to use the Pythagorean theorem in trigonometric problems.
Review the steps for finding all ratios from a single given ratio.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review of key concepts and formulas.
